description: This file is a PHP script embedded in an XHTML template, designed to interact with a network device management API. It performs operations such as retrieving, setting, adding, and deleting NAT (Network Address Translation) port mapping configurations, as well as managing DMZ settings. The script includes multiple API calls (DmGetStrsWithRootObj, DmSetStrsWithRootObj, DmGetInstanceIds, DmAddObj, DmDelObj) and outputs the results for debugging or testing purposes.
